I ran the new LLM analyzer cases and the existing Bedrock meta tests on 5b2172e: 11 passed. apply_model_constraints now drops temperature for the LLM, meta, readiness, and alignment clients. Opus 4.6, Sonnet 4.5, Sonnet 4.6, and Haiku 4.5 still send it. Opus 4.7 through anthropic/, vertex_ai/, and bedrock/ omits it, along with Opus 4.8, Opus 5, Sonnet 5, Haiku 5, and Fable 5.

Medium. Claude Mythos still sends temperature and will 400. Anthropic documents that temperature is rejected on Claude 4.7 and later and on Claude Mythos Preview, and the current Mythos IDs are claude-mythos-5, claude-mythos-5-1, and claude-mythos-preview. The matcher never looks for mythos, so all of these still send the parameter:

anthropic/claude-mythos-5
anthropic/claude-mythos-5-1
anthropic/claude-mythos-preview
bedrock/anthropic.claude-mythos-5
Add mythos the same way as Fable, and cover claude-mythos-5 in the shared constraint test.

Low. The bare fable alternative matches any model id that contains that word. anthropic/claude-fable-5 correctly omits temperature. openai/fable-gpt-4o also omits it, so a non-Claude deployment with that name loses sampling control. Require a Claude-shaped id, such as claude-fable or fable-[5-9].

An explicitly configured temperature is dropped with no log line. That is the same silent omit Meta already used for Bedrock Opus 4.7, and sending the value is what causes the 400. I would not block on a warning.
